intended_object: A local short name (from the docstring) for `PhysicalParticularWave.WaveSpace`, i.e. the product type `(Parameter × ℝ) × Plane`, a coordinate space used internally in a Navier–Stokes construction.
explanation: The declaration is only an `abbrev` that renames an existing type from another file of the same library, `PhysicalParticularWave.WaveSpace := (Parameter × ℝ) × Plane`, for use in this file. It adds no mathematical content of its own. It is a naming convenience and an internal detail of a project-specific construction, not a standard mathematical object, so it cannot be compared with a definition in the literature.
